mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_id, password, name, grade, class_name, class_number, register_year, total_coupon, total_point, created_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{grade}, #{className}, #{classNumber}, YEAR(NOW()), 0, 100000, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT name, grade, class_name, class_number, total_point, password FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT MAX(s.id) AS id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY (MAX(s.total_point) + COALESCE(MAX(se.eval_total), 0)) DESC, s.student_id ASC ) AS `rank`, s.student_id AS studentId, MAX(s.name) AS name, MAX(s.grade) AS grade, MAX(s.class_name) AS className, MAX(s.class_number) AS classNumber, MAX(s.total_point) AS totalPoint, COALESCE(MAX(se.eval_total), 0) AS stockEvaluation, (MAX(s.total_point) + COALESCE(MAX(se.eval_total), 0)) AS totalAsset, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coupon_purchase cp JOIN students s2 ON (cp.student_id = s2.id OR cp.student_id = CAST(s2.id AS CHAR) OR cp.student_id = s2.student_id) WHERE s2.student_id = s.student_id AND cp.state = '사용전' ), 0) AS totalCoupon FROM students s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.student_id, SUM( (CASE WHEN o.content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN o.amount ELSE -o.amount END) * COALESCE( (SELECT o2.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o2 ON t.buy_order_id = o2.order_id WHERE o2.stock_id = o.stock_id ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), stk.publication_price ) ) AS eval_total FROM orders o JOIN stocks stk ON o.stock_id = stk.stock_id WHERE o.state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') GROUP BY o.student_id ) se ON (se.student_id = s.student_id OR se.student_id = CAST(s.id AS CHAR)) WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.student_id NOT LIKE '%test%' AND s.name NOT LIKE '%테스트%' AND s.name NOT LIKE '%검증%' GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY `rank` ASC LIMIT 100
SELECT COALESCE(total_point, 0) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} OR CAST(id AS CHAR) = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO get_points (student_id, point, content, created_date) SELECT id, #{point}, #{content}, NOW() FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} OR id = CAST(#{studentId} AS UNSIGNED) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR id = CAST(#{studentId} AS UNSIGNED)) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE students SET total_point = 1000000, total_coupon = 0, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE student_id = #{studentId} OR CAST(id AS CHAR) = #{studentId}
UPDATE students SET total_point = #{defaultPoint}, total_coupon = 0, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE students SET status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE status = 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT student_id AS studentId, SUM(point) AS netAdjustment FROM get_points WHERE content LIKE '%관리자%' GROUP BY student_id HAVING SUM(point) != 0
